entries.label: gates-and-book-links
command:
set -euo pipefail
cargo fmt --all --check
python3 scripts/check-sql.py
scripts/check-book-links.sh
cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo clippy --locked -p physician-app -p duet-app -p mobile -p ui-gallery -p extension-popup --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features physician-app/web,duet-app/web,mobile/web,ui-gallery/web,extension-popup/web -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked -p boundaries

entries.label: duet-api-client-app-public-site-android
command:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p duet-client
cargo test --locked -p duet-app
cargo test --locked -p public-site
cargo test --locked -p android
cargo test --locked -p duet-api

entries.label: chromium-wasm-mobile-journeys
command:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p mobile --lib
cargo test --locked -p mobile --test mode -- --ignored
cargo test --locked -p mobile --test duet_journey
cargo test --locked -p mobile --test duet_journey -- --ignored --skip durable_doctor::backend_process --test-threads=1
